scope: Saved runtime FPS read intent in main GUI EN/RU, CLI and IPC; FPS-only invalidation and manager completion race repair. Private files/Unix IPC, MockBackend and isolated Xvfb/session D-Bus/WebKit only. No production daemon, host D-Bus, game logging activation, physical HID or installation.
implementation: Global version1/revision/enabled/log_path record, explicit get/set IPC and CLI with CAS; atomic no-follow bounded persistence, interprocess lock and retained bounded admission workers. Saved disabled overrides legacy environment fallback after restart.

Runtime watch switches the reader on the next host collection. Publishing a changed record immediately invalidates FPS, including delayed pre-change samples; CPU/GPU values are untouched. Each new attachment skips historical log rows.

Main Settings card is usable without a device; explicit Save/Load, EN default/RU, absolute UTF-8 path <=384bytes. Disable retains path. Conflict and lost-write reply require explicit readback; polling and late unmounted replies do not replace drafts.
Manager command queue/reply wait now also observes manager completion. This covers both power transitions and firmware handoff without cancelling manager-owned teardown.

checks.frontend_svelte_checks: npx svelte-check --threshold error and npm run check: 0 errors/0 warnings
checks.frontend_lint: no lint script configured; npm run lint --if-present exits0; no dependency added
checks.frontend_build: passed; frontend source unchanged through final native run

native.flow: Actual DOM controls through Tauri IPC and private Unix fixture; EN fresh disabled -> enable Cyrillic path rev1 -> RU -> disable retains path rev2 -> GUI+fixture daemon restart -> same RU/disabled/path/revision. Zero devices/HID writes and source CSV unchanged. GUI closes and fixture processes join.
native.limits: No pointer/keyboard/screen-reader/full desktop session or real game qualification.

initial_failed_verification.reason: Manually terminated own hung manager_lifecycle process after preserving debugger evidence; this run is not counted as passing.
initial_failed_verification.observation: Root future was in final prepare_for_sleep(false) after shutdown. done watch=true with sender gone; power receiver closed, queue tail5/index4, reply sender still retained, all runtime threads parked and no blocked HID worker.
initial_failed_verification.repair: Observe manager completion across queue admission and reply waiting; deterministic test retains the reply sender deliberately, then publishes completion and requires pending/new request failure. Existing integration now bounds the post-shutdown check.
initial_failed_verification.final_result: Full workspace passes; original lifecycle case passes16 consecutive runs.

limits: Logged frame mean remains distinct from Windows HWiNFO PresentedAvg/application identity.
No activation/configuration of MangoHud logging or automatic active application selection. Producer must supply supported per-frame schema/log_interval=0.
Real games, permissions/filesystem-stall/performance/platform matrix, full Plasma/GNOME Shell and hardware acceptance remain pending.
Mini remains Plasma widget/GNOME Shell extension; no standalone window. Sway/other environments deferred; supported shell versions remain undecided.
English default and Russian mandatory; additional languages/effects deferred to polishing.
